info.title: svitlo4u API
info.description: Power state, outage schedules and analytics. Instants are Unix ms, dates are local YYYY-MM-DD in the site's time zone, durations are ms. Responses are not cached.

kind.description: outage: next planned outage starts; restore: power is off, the planned window ends; window-in-progress: power is on although a planned window runs until `at`

anyOf.description: Next planned change (by schedule, not a promise)

get.description: text/event-stream. On connect: `state` (same body as /state). Then: `state` after every change, `power` {state, at, detectedAt, approximate}, `false-alarm` {outageStartedAt}, `schedule` {kind, title, body, …}, `reminder` {kind, leadMinutes, start, end, power}, `voltage` {t, voltage}. Comment lines every 25 s keep the stream open. No replay: a reconnecting client gets a fresh `state`.
